ctx.x: You know, he learns in the home, though. Well, yeah. I'll just give him, come up his own way, you know. My idea about it. Joe used to tell him, blow below him, saw it. Oh. Ask him where he got the name Liberty Bell. Say, why did y'all get the name Liberty Bell? What did he get?
Why did you get that name Liberty Bell? I get him that name. Oh, you get him that name.
